description: Registry entries (type and IMS stack fork) of the keys the per-device records use (rule round 30, spec 2.5.1), so that a record's key keeps its type when neither the public schema nor the Google lane has it, or when the Google lane drops it. fork is null for a key of the stack itself; source says where the key is defined.

gps.longterm_psds_server_1.source: Android GNSS configuration key, in Google's CarrierSettings default

imsvoice.voice_on_default_bearer_in_roam.source: OCD's ImsStack fork (S20 project rom-repos/platform_packages_modules_ImsStack.git, branch ocd), java/assets/carrier_config/carrier_config.xml line 170, default false

imsvoice.voice_on_default_bearer_support.source: AOSP ImsStack imsvoice.* key (LineageOS 23.2), also in Google's CarrierSettings
